lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are distributed in a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region, with a transition to larger, more isolated centroids in the posterior mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical and diagonal bands of elevated luminance intersect with primary blobs in the upper mid-flank, creating a networked, maze-like pixel structure.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear ridge is visible in the upper third of the frame, defined by a sharp transition from high-luminance pixels on the dorsal edge to low-luminance shadow pixels on the ventral edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two distinct, nearly parallel horizontal linear scars of high luminance (hypopigmentation) are located in the upper-central flank; a diffuse reddish-brown circular lesion is visible dorsal to these marks.
other_distinctive_markers: The upper mid-flank exhibits elongated, worm-like 'vermiculated' luminance patterns connecting multiple spot centroids.
